name: input-group
title: InputGroup
description: A text input with prefixes and suffixes attached (icons, text such as a scheme or a unit, ghost buttons), in one frame that shows focus, invalid and disabled; works inside a Field.
usage: Use InputGroup when something belongs to the input: a search icon, a fixed prefix (postgres://), a unit (ms), or an action on the value (Copy, Test, Show). Put InputGroupAddon and InputGroupButton before or after InputGroupInput in the order they should appear, and wrap the group in a Field for its label and error. For an unrelated action next to an input, use a plain Input and a Button side by side.

props.name: size
props.description: Frame height from size.control.*, which follows data-density; InputGroupButton is one size smaller.

props.name: render
props.description: Base UI render prop: render another element as the frame.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: input
slots.description: InputGroupInput, Base UI's Input without its own frame; data-slot="input-group-input".

slots.name: addon
slots.description: InputGroupAddon, an icon or text; data-slot="input-group-addon".

parts.name: InputGroupInput
parts.description: The text control (Base UI's Input): takes a Field's label and validity; its value, onValueChange and onBlur as Input's.

parts.name: InputGroupAddon
parts.description: An icon or text in color.fg.muted; clicking it focuses the control.

parts.name: InputGroupButton
parts.description: A Button (ghost by default) one size smaller than the group, inset from the frame; Button's props.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: The control has focus: the frame shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring. The button shows its own ring instead.

states.name: invalid
states.description: The control is invalid (aria-invalid): the frame takes the danger border.

states.name: invalid-in-field
states.description: Invalid inside a Field (data-invalid on the control): the danger border.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The control is disabled: the whole frame dims to opacity.disabled.

accessibility: The control is a native <input>; give it a FieldLabel through a Field, or aria-label. Addon text is not part of its name: say in the label or description what a prefix means.
Mark decorative addon icons aria-hidden; an icon-only InputGroupButton needs aria-label.
Tab moves from the control to the button; the frame's ring follows the control, the button has its own focus ring.
Clicking an addon focuses the control, so the whole frame is a click target.
The frame border (color.border.strong) meets 3:1 against every surface; invalid uses color.status.danger.border and FieldError's message, not colour alone.
